name: Andorra: self-employed

tests: More than 183 days in Andorra, or the main centre of economic interests there

regimes.name: Passive residence
regimes.summary: Residence permit without work in Andorra; IRPF still applies to income, at up to 10%

source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Andorra, residence

prepayments.what: IRPF payment on account for business income (form 320), during September

calendar.note: IGI returns are half-yearly below EUR 250,000 of turnover (quarterly up to EUR 3.6 million, monthly above), due within the first 20 days of the month after the period. The IRPF return and payment for a year run from 1 April to 30 September of the next year.

workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

notes: CASS contributions of the self-employed are a monthly amount: enter them as fixed contributions.
General IGI rate 4.5%; IRPF ranges from 0% to 10%. Self-employed social security (CASS) is not included.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.

sources.title: Departament de Tributs i de Fronteres
